scope: Two public-font Java Canvas measurement routes and an independently derived integer advance formula compared with retained reference CLI exports. No native implementation change or new Rust execution is represented by this artifact.

historical_native_profile.expected_value_origin: Independently recomputed from the observed scale-1 public-font algorithm. These are model predictions, not a newly run Rust engine or a statement about future builds.
historical_native_profile.element_absence_semantics: null for absent element; original display CSV placeholder zero retained separately.

candidate_profile.name: public-roboto-fixed-150pct-integer-advances-candidate-v1
candidate_profile.rounding: Nonnegative nearest-integer with half ties upward at physical glyph quantization; sum physical integer advances before a single logical conversion. Logical scale-3/2 conversion has thirds, so no half ties occur there.
candidate_profile.arithmetic: Use checked unsigned integer multiplication/addition and fail unknown on overflow. Do not round each logical char width or accumulate floating point charWidth results.
candidate_profile.unsupported_scripts: Existing native unknown policy retained for combining sequences, emoji, Arabic, CJK and other unsupported/fallback-dependent scripts.

controlled_transform_experiment.method: Headless BufferedImage; same explicit public font, same antialiasing=false and fractional_metrics=false; only Graphics2D.scale changes between1 and1.5. No desktop, application config or OS DPI change.

limitations: Reference comparisons are one small authored local fixture under one current Windows/JDK/DPI profile.
Complex-script reference BasicHTML behavior, normalization, fallback fonts, arbitrary strings, Linux/macOS and other device scales are not proven.
Matching ASCII widths does not identify an identical upstream font binary or prove all hinting behavior.
Public v2.138 unhinted release Java measurements differ and show why a version-label-only asset swap is unsupported.
No actual Google SERP rendering or title/description truncation guarantee is implied.
Absent element placeholders are recorded but excluded from present-element match counts.
